verify_detail: st passes ~3 times out of 5: it\'s asserting on a value the app itself randomizes at startup, not on a stable piece of UI.\n\n**Recommendation for the test team:** either stub/seed the sync-status source for the test build so it\'s deterministic, or have the test drive the status into "idle" explicitly (e.g., via a test-only intent extra or by tapping "Retry sync"\'s equivalent health-check action) before asserting visibility, rather than relying on whatever the cold-start random draw produces.'
